principles: The language model is not the source of truth.
Vehicle facts and technical claims must come from normalized tools or approved evidence.
Vehicle-specific procedures and specifications require appropriate primary authoritative evidence.
Diagnostic decisions fail closed when evidence is insufficient.
Training and technician response policies are distinct.
Only privacy-minimized diagnostic context is sent to model providers.

components.role: Durable vehicle, complaint, evidence, test, decision, and verification state
Intent, context, capability, and tool routing
Language interpretation, synthesis, explanation, and response drafting only
Resolve VIN and entered metadata into a normalized vehicle identity with unresolved fields
Route approved automotive tools through typed adapters and normalizers
Hybrid retrieval and reranking from approved knowledge
Authority, relevance, vehicle match, currency, and sufficiency checks
Deterministic diagnostic state, hypotheses, tests, evidence, and verification
Require technician verification and fail closed on unsafe or unsupported output
Render evidence-supported structured decisions into mode-appropriate language
Trace claim to evidence, source, retrieval, and decision

externalTools.notes: vPIC API is rate controlled; standalone database may be used for VIN decoding resilience.

rag.rule: Unapproved documents must not become retrievable model context.

privacyBoundaries: Do not send account identity to the model provider.
Do not send raw VIN to the model provider unless a separately approved use case requires it.
Keep diagnostic technical data separate from account, telemetry, and training analytics identities.
